description: 32 decidable submission cases over the Meridian Review handling rules, every one requiring two or more rules to combine. Probes X01-X16 were written and validated first; X17-X32 were added with a PREDICTION recorded before they were run -- that joints where a NUMBER meets a REGIME (paired vs solo limits, inclusive boundaries) discriminate between a spec-holder and a 230-word brief, and that categorical overrides (R7 retraction, R6 Track D, R10 withdrawal) do not. The field 'predicted_discriminating' carries that prediction per probe so it can be scored rather than remembered.
